claim.date_text_original: HRW field report 2003 and ILO national review 2005
claim.spatial_precision: multiple states/sectors with independently documented bounded examples; no national prevalence surface
claim.summary: A 2005 ILO review found bonded labour persisting across many sectors and Indian states despite legal abolition, while independent Human Rights Watch field research documented bonded child labour in the silk industry in Karnataka, Tamil Nadu and Uttar Pradesh. The atlas records a positive debt-bondage claim for this 2003–2005 evidence window while preserving strong regional, sectoral and population heterogeneity.
